# read-jobs-v1 portable fixtures

All `TEST-ONLY-*` secrets and identities are public synthetic test data, never deployment credentials. Fixed timestamp 1793059200 is intentionally expired; freeze the test clock at this timestamp. No PDF/content is embedded.

`preflight.json` records the canonical UTF-8 string, hex bytes, synthetic runner secret, asset and hex HMAC-SHA256. Canonical JSON is sorted keys, compact separators, unescaped Unicode, UTF-8, no NaN. Preflight includes `version:read-preflight-v1` and every asset field except signature, including null paper_id. Each lifecycle file records the exact request body bytes, signature fields, headers and representative successful response.

Sign **the full externally requested path**: client `/api/v1/me/read-jobs`, runners `/api/internal/read-jobs/rj_fixture_v1/{claim,heartbeat,complete}`. The mounted v1 application retains the `/api/v1` prefix in `request.url.path`. Do not sign the sub-application relative route, host, query or trailing slash. Runner key_id is the literal `-`; client key_id comes from the connect token/active introspection response, never grant_id or token prefix. Transport HMAC is lowercase hex without `v1=`. Method is uppercase POST; timestamp is a 10-digit string; body_sha256 hashes the **exact transmitted bytes**. Retrying a request uses a new timestamp/nonce/signature but the same idempotency key and body.

claim sends exact `{}` (or empty body), heartbeat sends fence, complete sends the termination receipt. `execution_stopped=true` is required for settlement. Heartbeat every 30s, 60s lease, deadline up to configured max_seconds. On lost lease/revocation stop execution; unknown retains credit hold/resource reservation until trusted termination. Never refund from a network error. Failed/cancelled confirmed terminal refunds credits while consumed resource units remain settled. Signed preflight is valid for at most 15 minutes and must still be valid at claim; execution itself is allowed past preflight expiry within its lease/deadline.

Response timestamps/job_id/digests are examples, not a production receipt. Per-PDF 30 credits/10 units are test values; live price and capacity require separate approval. No real read/AI gates are enabled by these fixtures. `pytest tests/test_read_jobs_shared_fixtures.py` verifies the vectors; mounted HTTP PostgreSQL tests verify actual routing and accounting separately.
